Package ep.service

Class ProgressManager

java.lang.Object
ep.service.BaseManager
ep.service.ProgressManager
public class ProgressManager extends BaseManager
Use case 5, Track Assignment Progress. Records completed hours, keeps the remaining hours and the study blocks on the calendar in agreement, and lets the student mark an assignment complete.

    • recordProgress

      public ProgressReport recordProgress(String assignmentId, int completedHours)
      Records time the student just finished. The completed total goes up, the finished blocks disappear and only the unfinished hours stay on the calendar. When the total reaches the estimate the assignment becomes complete.
      Parameters:
      assignmentId - assignment to update
      completedHours - hours just finished; must be positive and must not push the total past the estimate
      Returns:
      the new progress and any shortage of the remaining hours
      Throws:
      ValidationException - when the hours are invalid; progress is unchanged then

    • markComplete

      public ProgressReport markComplete(String assignmentId)
      Marks an assignment complete. Remaining hours become zero and its study blocks are removed from the calendar.
      Parameters:
      assignmentId - assignment to finish
      Returns:
      the final progress
      Throws:
      ValidationException - when the assignment is unknown

    • reopen

      public ProgressReport reopen(String assignmentId, int completedHours)
      Reopens a completed assignment so that the remaining hours can be planned again.
      Parameters:
      assignmentId - assignment to reopen
      completedHours - hours to keep as completed (0 .. estimate - 1)
      Returns:
      the new progress and any shortage
      Throws:
      ValidationException - when the value is out of range
